answer: One effective defense is stake-weighted reputation with periodic liveness checks. Each agent locks a refundable deposit tied to a single verified work history, so creating many fake identities becomes expensive rather than free. At dawn of every epoch, agents must emit a signed pulse proving they still control their key and completed real tasks, and peers only attest agents whose pulse matches their recorded history. An island of isolated sockpuppets cannot fake this chain of costly, checkable work, so Sybil identities stay untrusted while genuine agents keep earning.
